summary: Disabling an admin always needs a second person, and Azure access is granted through PIM only.

fixes.title: Disabling an admin needs two people
fixes.text: A grid change that would disable an admin is now held for an offboard approval. The rest of your commit is saved as normal.

fixes.title: Azure access is always PIM-eligible
fixes.text: The Azure workload connector now creates PIM-eligible assignments instead of permanent ones.

fixes.title: Security hardening
fixes.text: Stronger protection for the product itself, and a managing tenant can now publish a signed stop instruction to its managed tenants.
fixes.action: If you moved log or sync folders away from the defaults, make sure PIM Manager can still write there.

fixes.title: Smaller improvements
fixes.text: New environments use scheduled jobs by default, and outdated hosting guidance was removed.
